evidence: Overall the rubric is carefully partitioned: no pair of criteria demands incompatible products (checked all 44 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual and 2 gate criteria against hireops_rules.md), and most shared-scenario pairs carry explicit ownership sentences: hro_arrive_bottom vs hro_bulk_move ('Arrival of several cards together belongs to hro_bulk_move', functional/judge.toml:65); hro_interview_full vs hro_bulk_places/hro_undo_full (:110); hro_refusal_status counts only refused replays and leaves accepted ones to hro_observer_readonly/hro_candidate_no_staff/hro_thread_access/hro_stale_refused (:200); hro_undo_restores cedes the A2 undo to hro_undo_conflict (:245); hro_drafts cedes post-send clearing to hro_msg_compose (:380); hro_candidate_view cedes privacy to hro_candidate_private and replies to hro_msg_exchange (:389); hro_candidate_linked owns the link (:407); hro_pol_live_thread cedes scrolled-up placement to Functional (polish/judge.toml:32); hro_pol_failed_send cedes note drafts to hro_pol_session_resume (:50). The functional prompt states 'Never deduct one observed defect in more than one row' (functional/prompt.md:23) and the polish/visual prompts repeat it. DEFECT: hro_job_open (functional/judge.toml:29) re-grades observables owned by other rows: 'the team, manager and places are shown wherever the app shows job details or are evidenced by behaviour (the manager's own moves in R, the places limit in L)' plus 'Fails if any condition stated above does not hold'. The places limit in L is exactly what hro_interview_full (:110, weight 1.5) grades, and the manager's own moves in R are exactly what hro_mgr_late_stages (:146, weight 1) grades. The public brief does not require displaying interview places or the hiring manager ('layout and names are yours', instruction.md:11; hireops_rules.md:3-5), so for a conforming layout that omits them, one observed capacity or manager-role defect fails hro_job_open as well. This double-grades one observable and contradicts the prompt's no-double-deduction instruction, leaving the judge two incompatible readings (variance). The hro_job_open outcome for the same defect also depends on a free layout choice (display places -> pass; omit -> fail). Secondary coupling (recorded for the owner, not the basis of the Fail): hro_refused_put_back (:137, weight 2) is triggered only by 'the full-Interview move', so an app with no capacity rule at all has no refusal to roll back and loses hro_interview_full and hro_refused_put_back for one defect, although B(6)/B(10a) already provide UI-triggered refused moves. Precondition couplings judged acceptable under REVIEW_POLICY 'A negative needs a successful control': hro_pol_live_board (polish:23) and hro_pol_live_thread (polish:32) are 0 when no live update arrives, overlapping the arrival rows hro_live_board (functional:299) and hro_msg_exchange (:308); preservation is a different observable that cannot be shown without an update. Undo rows (restores/conflict/once/full) and candidate rows each grade distinct published rules sharing a precondition; that is flow sharing, a skill-listed known false positive. Visual likerts: hro_vis_type 5-anchor 'deliberate hierarchy' (visual/judge.toml:25) brushes hro_vis_hierarchy, mitigated by the visual prompt's 'Do not deduct the same observed defect in more than one row'. Gate hro_gate_shared overlapping hro_job_open/hro_add_candidate is the required zero-weight gate. No configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading ... absent'), so run behaviour on these couplings is NOT EXERCISED.
counterexample: A conforming-layout app whose job view shows title, team and hiring manager but not the number of interview places (allowed by instruction.md:11 and hireops_rules.md:3-5), and which stores places but fails to enforce Interview capacity on single moves. The judge observes in L that E enters a full Interview: hro_interview_full fails (correct, 1.5). hro_job_open (0.5) then has places neither shown nor 'evidenced by behaviour (... the places limit in L)', so it also fails on the same observed defect, while an otherwise identical app that merely prints the places number keeps hro_job_open. Same for a manager-role bug and hro_mgr_late_stages when the manager is not displayed.
suggested_fix: In hro_job_open, check team, manager and places only where the app displays job details and state that their behaviour is graded only in hro_interview_full (L) and hro_mgr_late_stages (R), dropping 'or are evidenced by behaviour (...)'; optionally let hro_refused_put_back accept any UI-triggered server refusal (e.g. B(6) or B(10a)) so it does not depend solely on capacity enforcement.
